Atlantis - The Lost Empire.name: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
Atlantis - The Lost Empire.summary: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire for Game Boy Advance is a platform game based on the 2001 animated film. Players control Milo Thatch across ten levels as he travels with the expedition to Atlantis. Each stage has specific objectives, such as rescuing crew members or escaping hazardous areas, as well as optional crystal and letter collection. Gameplay focuses on platforming, avoiding hazards, using tools such as dynamite and drills, and solving simple environmental puzzles.

Daredevil.name: Daredevil
Daredevil.summary: Daredevil for the Game Boy Advance is your basic punch-kick-jump action platformer featuring Marvel's more unlikely superhero, a blind lawyer with enhanced abilities and senses. Though the game was marketed as a tie-in with the February 14th release of the Daredevil film, the GBA title is more based upon a less realistic, comic book design with bright and vibrant colors and the occasional "Pow!" and "Bif!" when knocking out opponents. Some levels cut across rooftops, others over vehicles in traffic; some go in buildings and underground. As players get through the 23 different levels, they'll uncover the game's original plot through comic book-style cutscenes.

Mortal Kombat - Deadly Alliance.name: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance
Mortal Kombat - Deadly Alliance.summary: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance is a 2002 fighting game developed and published by Midway for the Xbox, PlayStation 2, GameCube, and Game Boy Advance. This is the Game Boy Advance port. It was the first all-new Mortal Kombat fighting game produced exclusively for home consoles, with no preceding arcade release.
